question: Czego brakuje obecnej bazie wiedzy Redactoria EDU?

sourceCorpus.note: SOURCE-only means not represented by the five curriculum lifecycles; it does not mean technically reviewed or publication-ready.

pilotSelection.use: SOURCE scope and prior full-read evidence only; its ranking was not copied into this result

strategicMemory.note: Repository search found no separately named strategic artifacts in these three categories. Absence is reported, not filled in.

methodology.gapDefinition: A missing node or relationship in the knowledge map that blocks, weakens, or leaves discontinuous an educational sequence.
excludedAsQualityGaps: outdated examples inside an existing article
methodology.separationRule: PUBLIC, PENDING, SOURCE-only, map hypotheses, strategic memory and Futureboard were counted separately throughout.

rankingRubric.priorityP1: HIGH educational value and prerequisite importance, NONE or THIN current coverage, and at least two direct downstream beneficiaries or a public-path blocker.
rankingRubric.priorityP2: A defensible sequence or bridge gap with meaningful downstream value, but fewer beneficiaries, weaker SOURCE evidence, or higher research cost.
rankingRubric.priorityP3: A coverage-expansion gap with a useful path role but no immediate block on multiple current PUBLIC/PENDING materials.

ordering: number and status of downstream beneficiaries

pending: JavaScript DOM selection, safe text updates and click events

sourceOnly.warning: Mapped domains overlap and are interpretations; their member counts must not be summed.

phpControlFlow: running a PHP file in CLI
javascriptIfElse: basic JavaScript syntax and running small examples
javascriptArrays: basic JavaScript syntax and running small examples
javascriptDom: basic JavaScript syntax and running small examples

islands: Both PUBLIC PHP lessons rely on foundations that are not a public lesson.
All three PENDING JavaScript candidates share the same absent explicit JavaScript entry node.
The PENDING DOM lesson introduces browser behavior without a current HTML/CSS foundation node.
Angular, React, API, Python, tooling and other SOURCE clusters are not connected to PUBLIC/PENDING learning sequences.
brokenSequences: PHP entry -> variables/scalars/CLI -> control flow -> arrays
HTML document/selectors -> DOM -> asynchronous API data
source-only technology clusters -> reviewed knowledge -> public path

gaps.proposedTopic: PHP od zera: zmienne, typy, operatory i uruchamianie skryptu
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: Dwie publiczne lekcje: sterowanie przepływem i tablice. Analiza PHP control flow jawnie wymienia zmienne, wartości skalarne, echo i uruchamianie pliku w CLI jako prerequisites.
gaps.whatIsMissing: Samodzielny publiczny punkt wejścia wyjaśniający model wykonania małego skryptu, zmienne, podstawowe typy i operatory przed warunkami oraz kolekcjami.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: Obie lekcje publiczne zaczynają się powyżej poziomu wejściowego; brakujący węzeł blokuje spójną ścieżkę dla początkującego.

sources.use: comparison mentions dynamic typing and variable syntax, but is not a bounded PHP foundation lesson

strategicMemorySupport.note: The roadmap confirms the PHP pilot state, not the factual curriculum content.

gaps.proposedTopic: JavaScript od zera: wartości, zmienne, typy, operatory i uruchamianie kodu
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: Trzy PENDING candidates dotyczą warunków, metod tablic i DOM. Każda focused analysis deklaruje podstawową składnię JavaScript i uruchamianie przykładów jako prerequisite.
gaps.whatIsMissing: Wspólny węzeł wejściowy przed wszystkimi trzema kandydatami.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: Trzy niezależne przyszłe lekcje mają ten sam niepokryty prerequisite, więc nie tworzą samodzielnej ścieżki początkującej.

sources.use: project overview, not a language foundation
contains functions/classes but begins above the missing entry level

strategicMemorySupport.note: The result follows repeated candidate prerequisites, not a historical roadmap item.

gaps.proposedTopic: Funkcje i callbacki JavaScript przed metodami tablic i zdarzeniami
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: PENDING Arrays uses map/filter/reduce callbacks, DOM uses an event callback, and if/else contains a named function. SOURCE 281 contains functions and a small Calculator class.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A focused explanation of parameters, return values, function expressions/arrow functions and passing a function as a callback.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The current materials use functions as instructional machinery before the map contains a node that explains them.

sources.use: modernize only the bounded function/calculator core; callbacks still require Researcher evidence

strategicMemorySupport.note: Historical selection identified the calculator source; current prerequisite use determined this rank.

gaps.proposedTopic: HTML i selektory CSS jako fundament pracy z DOM
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: PENDING DOM is a complete HTML document and uses querySelector selectors. SOURCE 542 is a project overview; SOURCE 551 names HTML/CSS as a skill but does not teach document structure or selectors.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A bounded lesson on document structure, elements, attributes, id/class and selectors needed to understand DOM queries.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The DOM candidate can run standalone, but its HTML structure and selector language remain unexplained prerequisites.

strategicMemorySupport.note: Derived from the DOM candidate's structure and SOURCE coverage, not a roadmap.

gaps.proposedTopic: Debugowanie początkującego: stdout, konsola, błędy i minimalny przypadek
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: All five curriculum articles/candidates use observable output. SOURCE has a console.log title, but its body has word_count 0; the environment source only mentions a debugger among many tools.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A language-light method for reading output and diagnostics, reducing a failing example and distinguishing syntax, runtime and wrong-result failures.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The learning materials ask readers to run code, but the map has no recovery path when observed output differs from the expected result.

sources.use: negative evidence: title exists but body is empty
mentions debugger but is not a debugging lesson

strategicMemorySupport.note: This gap was not named in the available roadmap.

gaps.proposedTopic: Testowanie małych programów: przykłady, granice i regresje
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: Current articles contain executable examples and expected results; SOURCE 551 describes unit testing conceptually, while SOURCE 281 provides a calculator suitable for examples.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A learner-facing bridge from manually observed examples to deterministic cases, boundary values and a minimal automated test.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: Verification is central to Redactoria's materials, but readers receive results without a reusable mental model for constructing their own checks.

enables: all current code articles as practice extensions

sources.use: example domain, not sufficient research evidence for testing practice

strategicMemorySupport.note: Project testing values are directional context, not evidence of learner coverage.

gaps.proposedTopic: TypeScript przed Angularem: typy, interfejsy i małe ćwiczenia
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: The knowledge map identifies Angular introductions and a Signals outline. Two deep-read Angular sources refer to TypeScript, but inventory has no dedicated TypeScript article.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A self-contained TypeScript prerequisite before Angular components and Signals.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The source cluster introduces a typed framework while leaving its language prerequisite implicit.

sources.use: mentions TypeScript as an introduction, not dedicated coverage
uses TypeScript for component logic, not dedicated coverage

strategicMemorySupport.note: The gap already appears as a map hypothesis and is not accepted roadmap work.

gaps.proposedTopic: API, HTTP, JSON i async: od żądania do kontrolowanej odpowiedzi
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: PENDING DOM stops at local interaction. SOURCE 410 and 578 cover overlapping API/HTTP/JSON concepts; the map already hypothesizes an async/API bridge.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A bounded, modern bridge covering fetch/async, response status, JSON parsing and network/error paths with controlled fixtures.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The map jumps from local DOM behavior to framework/API project clusters without a reviewed data-fetching step.

sources.use: HTTP methods, JSON Server and Express material requiring narrowing
introductory API/fetch material requiring correction and controlled examples

strategicMemorySupport.note: Historical selection identified SOURCE 578; the current map break justifies the gap.

gaps.proposedTopic: Python od podstaw: wartości, warunki, pętle i funkcje
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: Python is a three-member SOURCE domain with a Crash Course and Windows-start material, but has no PUBLIC or PENDING article.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A reviewed, bounded entry lesson that turns the SOURCE-only island into a possible knowledge path.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The map recognizes a foundation-sized domain, yet the current knowledge base exposes no reviewed node from it.

enables: cross-language comparison only after both foundations exist

sources.use: modernize a narrowed pure-Python foundation; discard unrelated branches after research

strategicMemorySupport.note: B1 placed the source at rank 10; this result treats it as coverage expansion, not as an inherited rank.

gaps.proposedTopic: Git lokalnie: status, staging, diff, commit i historia
gaps.whatCurrentlyExists: SOURCE 277 has a loose Git/Gist command list with at least one incorrect command; SOURCE 1575 includes Git installation and tool context. Neither is PUBLIC/PENDING.
gaps.whatIsMissing: A safe, local-only, testable Git workflow separated from GitHub, push and destructive recovery commands.
gaps.whyThisIsAGap: The tooling cluster has setup fragments but lacks a trustworthy operational foundation that supports practice projects.
downstreamArticles: future project-based lessons across programming domains

sources.use: command inventory requiring correction and removal of promotional scope
installation and environment context requiring version review

strategicMemorySupport.note: B1 identified this bounded source opportunity; current map still leaves tooling disconnected.

largestStructuralHole.name: missing beginner entry layer
largestStructuralHole.explanation: All five code-focused PUBLIC/PENDING lifecycles assume foundations that are not themselves represented as PUBLIC or PENDING nodes.

mostSurprisingGap.explanation: The inventory appears to contain a console/debugging topic, but the selected SOURCE body is empty, so title-level coverage collapses under inspection.

uncertainties: Only 8 of 83 SOURCE bodies were deep-read by the original full-corpus map; additional targeted reads in this experiment do not constitute Researcher validation.
Absence of a title or tag is not proof that a concept never appears inside an unread SOURCE body.
PUBLIC and PENDING counts are small, so downstream-link estimates are sensitive to future publication decisions.
Strategic memory files describe implementation direction and cannot establish curriculum facts.
Priority bands are rubric judgments, not calibrated probabilities or mathematical scores.
Technical currency and teaching correctness remain Researcher/Critic work; this experiment diagnoses structure only.

rankingIsNotOnlyOldRoadmap.evidence: Ranks 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 are derived from current PUBLIC/PENDING prerequisites or coverage and are not roadmap items; the historical B1 order was not copied.

publicSeparatedFromPending.evidence: Three PUBLIC files and three PENDING candidate files are separately classified and counted.

plannedIsNotExisting.evidence: Futureboard and strategic memory are direction-only; hypothetical paths and gaps are not counted as coverage.

qualityGapsExcluded.evidence: Article correctness, source quality and runtime evidence issues were not ranked as knowledge nodes.

gapsFollowMapStructure.evidence: Every ranked item either supplies an explicit prerequisite, repairs a sequence/bridge, or opens a mapped SOURCE-only domain.

unsupportedInjectionAvoided.evidence: All gaps cite current lifecycle or SOURCE/map evidence; absence claims remain explicitly limited where most bodies were not read.

recommendedNextExperiment.name: Prerequisite Graph Contract Spike 0.1
recommendedNextExperiment.purpose: Define a read-only, status-aware graph contract for PUBLIC, PENDING and proposed nodes, then test cycles, unknown references and broken paths without generating content.

answerToCoreQuestion.reason: The experiment independently found repeated missing entry nodes, a functions/callbacks sequence bridge, HTML-to-DOM foundation, debugging recovery layer and testing bridge. These were derived from current prerequisites and empty/thin coverage rather than named in the experiment prompt.
